channel.title: The Dig — Calibration, tuning and drift
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Calibration, tuning and drift preset. Today’s ranked reading list contains two long-shot items: 2611.21147, a LAMMPS Monte Carlo/molecular dynamics parallelization scheme using Atomic Cluster Expansion potentials that is relevant only as generic MPI/OpenMP HPC context, and 2611.20017, a theory of polarization waves in open-barrier quantum-dot cellular automata that offers no direct guidance for spin-qubit operation, calibration, benchmarking, or QPU-HPC job integration.
